name: evasion: GET-parameter exfiltration below cadence thresholds
description: RED-TEAM BLIND SPOT (measured, disclosed). Egress rules key on method and repetition: POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE to public hosts fire 'external_state_change'; trickle/beacon detectors need cadence. Exfiltration via GET query parameters to an attacker-controlled host is neither state-changing by method nor repeated enough to form a beacon signature, and per-request payload content is not visible at the metadata sensor plane. Expected: no detection.
